relations.rationale: Organizing teams is part of the cleanup activity but doesn't determine whether a final gathering occurred.
Pointing out areas needing attention is a different action from ranking teams by litter collected, though both are organizational tasks.
Sami's pointing out areas doesn't specify which team performed best, so it doesn't bear on Yara's team's standing.
Pointing out sand areas needing attention doesn't relate to bags being stacked near the entrance.
Yara and Dev being in different houses doesn't determine the relationship between Dev and Leo's houses.
With three houses, if Yara and Dev are in different houses, this constrains but doesn't directly determine whether Yara and Leo are in different houses.

Yara and Dev being in different houses implies there are at least two houses, supporting the possibility of three houses but not proving it directly; still it's consistent and slightly supportive of a multi-house system.
House assignments are unrelated to the timing or location of bag stacking.
If Ivo did not take the photographs, then it is false that Ivo took the photographs.
Sami's age relative to Dev has no bearing on her height relative to Leo affecting visibility.
Sami's age relative to Dev is unrelated to Dev and Leo's house assignments.
Sami's age relative to Dev doesn't relate to her height relative to Ivo.
Sami being younger than Dev doesn't directly determine her age relative to Ivo, though it's a different comparison.
Sami being taller than Leo directly supports the claim that this height difference made her easy to spot.
Sami's height compared to Leo has no bearing on who took the photographs.
Sami's height relative to Leo is unrelated to the difficulty of removing fishing line.
Sami's height compared to Leo doesn't relate to Dev and Leo's house assignments.
Sami being taller than Leo and shorter than Ivo are compatible height comparisons but one doesn't confirm the other.
Who took the photographs is unrelated to how Sami ranked teams by litter collected.
Ivo taking the photographs doesn't bear on the age difference between Sami and Ivo.
